description: This file defines a plugin component for a rich text editor, specifically a bulleted list block that integrates with the Lexical editor framework. It exports a function that returns configuration for inserting a bulleted list, including its name, icon, keywords, and the command to execute when selected.

methods.name: GetBulletedListBlock
methods.description: Creates and returns an object representing the bulleted list block plugin, including its metadata and the command to insert an unordered list into the Lexical editor.
